mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_runtime_binding (binding_id, user_id, scope_id, role, agent_id, framework_session_id, status, next_projection_at) VALUES (#{bindingId}, #{userId}, #{scopeId}, 'MASTER', #{agentId}, #{sessionId}, 'IDLE', #{nextProjectionAt})
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN t.cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL OR r.cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL OR j.cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'STOP_REQUESTED' WHEN t.status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') OR r.status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') OR j.status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'SUPERSEDED', 'SKIPPED') THEN 'FINISHED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END FROM sq_runtime_binding b LEFT JOIN sq_goal_task t ON t.user_id = b.user_id AND t.task_id = b.task_id LEFT JOIN sq_response_execution r ON r.user_id = b.user_id AND r.binding_id = b.binding_id LEFT JOIN sq_worker_job j ON j.user_id = b.user_id AND j.binding_id = b.binding_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.binding_id = #{bindingId}
